title: acer ningpoense
intro: Acer ningpoense, commonly known as the Ningpo maple, is a deciduous tree native to China. The Ningpo maple is known for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high antioxidant content. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal agent, as well as exhibiting anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Acer ningpoense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
